a.lede: After a shocking downfall, Nvidia’s CEO is out of a job. WIRED’s Lauren Goode explains what that means for the world’s most critical chip company, the AI industry, and Jensen Huang himself.
a.title: Jensen Huang Is Gone. Now What?

b.lede: In the aftermath of Jensen Huang's resignation, not only may the AI bubble pop, but the world economy is in some peril
b.title: Most affairs don't matter except to the people involved. Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen's blunder will rock the world
